topology: tree3: core + two access switches, tables 3,500, idle 10 s, all monitored, one defense instance per switch; one controller; 300 s, attack at 50 s; new-connection probe on; OVS inactivity probe 30 s

benign_scale.rule: preregistered: largest of 1.0 / 0.75 / 0.5 passing G0 (lost first packets <= 0.1 %, probes 100 %) on seed 4110, then G0 on every test seed

step2_0.75.4120: lost 0.17 %, probes 34 / 96 % (start-up burst: about 500 Packet-In/s and a 110-event controller backlog from 20 to 66 s)

benign_scale.decision: the user chose (2026-11-04) scale 0.5 and a lost-first-packet bar at the measured noise floor (<= 0.25 %; light-load runs measured 0.05-0.18 %), probes still 100 %; decided before any defense ran on the test seeds
benign_scale.G0_result: passed at 0.5 on every test seed (lost first packets <= 0.25 %, probes 100 %)

final_system.name: ensguard (FL-EnsGuard)
final_system.description: federated RF (50 trees, depth 12) + CatBoost by model sharing from D1-D3, soft vote; evict entries scoring >= tau (0.1 % benign budget on T1's trace validation benign); block a host whose evictions in 10 s are >= 50 and >= 3x the median host's (60 s, doubling, at most 240 s); PortGuard (weighted fair share, mode full) as fallback; host identity with port security

outcome: benign_harmed_pct from testbed/summarize_run.py (benign flow refused, blocked or evicted/deleted and back, at any switch on its path)
test: one-sided exact sign test on paired runs (same variant, same seed); a tie counts against the hypothesis; Holm within each hypothesis family; alpha 0.05

hypotheses.H1: T1, A2 / A4 / E9P, 5 seeds: ensguard harms fewer benign flows than each of evict, SIFT, TableGuard, DMS-BTT, FTMaster, FTOP, rDefender and FL-DualGuard (dualguard+portguard+hostid) over the 15 paired runs (Holm over the 8)
hypotheses.H2: T1, A2 / A4 / E9P, 5 seeds: ensguard's average attack share of the core table (attack_share_avg_pct_s11) is below each of the same 8 over the 15 paired runs (Holm over the 8)
hypotheses.H3: T1, benign only, 5 seeds: ensguard's mean benign harm <= 0.5 % and mean lost first packets <= 1 % (descriptive thresholds)
hypotheses.H4: no benign host is blocked in any of ensguard's 20 runs (descriptive; the count is reported)

also_reported: the papers' columns per switch (avg/max attack share, table usage, earliest overflow, overflow seconds, Packet-In, Table-Full), lost first packets, probe success, flow-mods, decision time, controller and switch CPU, controller RSS, attackers blocked and time to first block; no defense as the reference
deviations: preregistration v2 (results/testbed_prereg, hash c014b64a) is superseded: its T1 campaign was stopped after seed 4110 (44 runs) and 2 runs of 4111 because the tree testbed was overloaded even without attack (benign-only lost first packets 12.8 %, switches disconnecting); those runs are reported as an invalid-testbed deviation, not as results

the system changed after those runs: the redesign (evict, outlier block, PortGuard fallback, RF + CatBoost) was developed and selected on simulator development seeds only and tested once on fresh simulator seeds 26000-26004 before this preregistration; it was also shaped by the stopped v2 testbed results (for example, drop rules on benign hosts)

G0 changed after calibration: 0.75 failed on seeds 4120 (start-up burst) and 4123 (0.12 %), so the benign scale is 0.5 and the lost-first-packet bar 0.25 % (the measured noise floor) instead of 0.1 %; decided before any defense ran on these seeds
benign load on the testbed is 0.5 of the trace's replay rate (the simulator uses 1.0); attacks are unchanged
the controller scores the forests with scikit-learn 1.3.2 refits that are identical to the simulator's (max difference 0.0) and CatBoost with a NumPy evaluator (parity 6e-17)
each switch runs its own instance of every defense (the published defenses were described for one switch)
SIFT and TableGuard parameters as selected by gate G1 on validation seeds
